releaseNotes.zh: 新增本周菜单、已有数据的 Agent 编辑、本机备份恢复和临期提示。做完后核对实际用量再扣库存。手动操作不消耗 AI 点；备份文件未加密，请妥善保存。需要邀请码，请覆盖安装保留数据。
releaseNotes.en: Weekly menus, reviewed Agent edits, local backup/restore and an expiry brief. Confirm actual use before deducting stock. Manual tools use no AI credits; keep unencrypted backups private. Invite required; install over the existing app to retain data.
